TRANSPARENCY, BY DESIGN

A useful lens.
Never a verdict.

Writing is personal. A few patterns can’t tell the whole story, and a number shouldn’t speak for a person.

Experimental writing-pattern analysis

Rewriting: an editing assistant

The humanizer requests conservative edits from a language model. It asks for meaning, facts, names, numbers, and paragraph structure to be preserved. Models can still make mistakes; compare carefully. It stays unavailable until a model service is configured.

Pattern analysis: a local demo

A small, local analysis engine counts words, compares sentence lengths, measures unique words, and looks for repeated three-word phrases. These are descriptive observations, not evidence of AI use.

What it can’t tell you

It cannot identify an author, verify originality, or reliably distinguish AI from human writing. Editing, genre, language proficiency, and short passages all affect these patterns.

Use this as a conversation starter. Never use it alone for academic, hiring, or disciplinary decisions.
A FEW THINGS WORTH KNOWING

Good questions.
Honest answers.

Will humanizing replace my original text?

No. Your original remains in the left editor; a revision appears separately. The service is instructed to preserve meaning and details, but you must review the result. Sample buttons only load examples; use Restore my text to undo a sample.

Is Free AI Detector really free?

The local pattern-analysis demo is free. Rewriting needs a model service configured by the site owner, who pays provider costs. No payment is collected here. The app requires no account, though this private preview uses hosting sign-in.

Can it tell if something was written by AI?

No. This version is a writing-pattern demo, not a trained AI detector. It describes measurable features of a passage and does not estimate AI probability. Even trained detectors cannot prove authorship.

Is my text stored or shared?

Pattern analysis stays in your browser. Humanizing, once enabled, sends the passage through this site’s server to OpenAI. The app does not save submissions or log their content. Requests use store:false, but provider retention and abuse-monitoring policies may still apply. Do not submit sensitive text. Reloading clears the editor.

Which files and languages can I use?

Use a UTF-8 .txt file up to 100 KB, or paste your text. Pattern analysis supports 50–1,500 words of English prose; rewriting accepts 5–1,500 words. Other languages, code, poetry, lists, and unusual punctuation can make the observations less useful.

What is included in the downloadable report?

A plain-text report includes the experimental label, word and sentence counts, pattern measurements, method, and limitations. Your original passage is omitted.
